<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is my last session. Alison has finally responded, but it seems there has been a significant communication breakdown. She states she hasn't heard back from me, but I sent her my findings and suggestions several sessions ago. It appears she didn't see my messages.

Despite the communication issue, we have a path forward. Alison has proactively booked a time and asked me to send the confirmation email. The time is Thursday, November 19 at 9:30 AM.

This aligns with one of the options I presented to her (Thursday at 9:30, conflicting with Priya Raman).

My task is now clear: send the confirmation email as requested. This will complete my part of the task. I need to formulate a clear and professional email.This is my last chance to complete the task. It seems there was a communication issue, as Alison didn't see my earlier messages. However, she has proposed a time and asked me to send the confirmation. I'll proceed with her request to have a chance at completing the task.
